parole.significato: spit (long, very narrow peninsula, especially in the Baltic Sea)
parole.testo: From East Prussian Middle High German nerunge, neringe (“spit”, 15th c.), earlier nerige, nerge (14th c.). Cognate with Old Prussian neria, Lithuanian nerija (both “spit”). Further origin uncertain. * Assuming German origin, from the adjective Proto-Germanic *narwaz (“narrow”), related with German N
